method: Transfer learning, feature extraction: ImageNet ResNet18 backbone frozen, only the linear head is trained (AdamW lr 3e-3, OneCycle)
explanation: Val accuracy 0.775 - WORSE than the small CNN trained from scratch (E3 0.936) and the SVM (E1b 0.813). With the backbone frozen only 3.6k parameters are learned; ImageNet features describe natural-photo objects ('what is it'), while this task is about rendering style of the SAME object across vendors (outline thickness, shading, gradients). Generic features are not discriminative enough -> the backbone must be adapted (E5).
preprocessing: Alpha-composite on white background, then resize to 128 x 128 (bicubic), ImageNet normalisation
preprocessing_why: Default RGB conversion drops alpha and exposes vendor-specific junk colours under transparent pixels; compositing on white shows the emoji as a human sees it and removes that artefact. 128 px: closer to the resolution ImageNet features were learned at, still cheap.
